name: Abalone Age Determination Benchmark Dataset
description: The Abalone dataset predict the age of abalone (marine snails) from physical measurements without cutting the shell. Sourced from the Marine Resources Division of Tasmania, it contains 4,177 instances characterized by 8 physical attributes (sex, length, diameter, height, whole weight, shucked weight, viscera weight, shell weight) and the number of shell rings.
